key: KXNEXTJPNPM|Will Yuichiro Tamaki be the next Prime Minister of Japan?|If the first new person to hold Prime Minister of Japan after Issuance is Yuichiro Tamaki, then the market resolves to Yes. The market resolves based on who actually assumes the office of Prime Minister, not who is elected or nominated. Acting or interim appointments count as holding the position if they formally assume the office. The person must be different from whoever held the position at market issuance - if the same person continues in office through the expiration date, all markets resolve to No. For countries where the equivalent position has a different title (e.g., Chancellor in Germany), the specific title will be used. Resolution is based on official announcements from the country's legislature or government, with The New York Times as a secondary source for confirmation.
reasoning: On October 21, 2025, Sanae Takaichi was elected and assumed the office of Prime Minister of Japan, becoming the first new Prime Minister after market issuance. She defeated Yuichiro Tamaki and other opposition candidates. Since the resolution criteria require the first new Prime Minister to be Yuichiro Tamaki for a YES resolution, and Sanae Takaichi was instead the first new PM to assume office, the market resolves to NO.
